thread:
ria-cs: Heads-up: Pilot customer BeaconRun seeing intermittent 429s during SDK bootstrap in an embedded WebView cluster. Demo in <24h, they're blocked. Can we triage?

paula-support: I can confirm support logs showing repeated `preflight` 429s and a bunch of near-simultaneous `token_refresh` attempts for org=beaconrun. Pattern looks like multiple contexts booting together.

ria-cs: Their repro: multiple embedded views + background sync all call SDK init on resume. Sample lines they pasted: 
[2026-03-25T09:04:01Z] init org=beaconrun status=200
[2026-03-25T09:04:01Z] init org=beaconrun status=429 msg="preflight"
[2026-03-25T09:04:01Z] worker.sync org=beaconrun status=200
[2026-03-25T09:04:02Z] init org=beaconrun status=429 msg="token_refresh"

omar-eng: Yep, classic multi-context fanout. SDK should singleflight preflight/token fetches but many apps don't coordinate across WebViews/tabs. Two paths: short-term server-side mitigation or client patch post-demo.

jun-sre: Dashboard spike: ~980 preflight rpm in the 60s window at 09:04. That's above our short-window guard. I can apply a per-org temporary coalescing rule and increase their burst allowance; need CS approval.

omar-eng: For a quick client workaround (post-demo) recommend BroadcastChannel or localStorage lock + singleton init promise + capped concurrent fetches and jittered exponential backoff on 429s. Example pattern we use internally: 
const bc = new BroadcastChannel('rw-init');
let initPromise = null;
function init() {
  if (initPromise) return initPromise;
  bc.postMessage('init-start');
  initPromise = fetch('/v1/preflight').finally(() => { initPromise = null; bc.postMessage('init-done'); });
  return initPromise;
}
Also send a stable `x-client-debounce-key` per logical session—gateway will collapse identical keys.

ria-cs: Customer can't ship changes before demo. They asked for a server-side quick fix.

jun-sre: I can enable coalescing for org=beaconrun and bump their short-window burst by +450 for 5 hours, and temporarily extend ephemeral token TTL from 20s->50s to reduce refresh storms. Need a CS thumbs-up.

paula-support: DM'd their technical contact; they approved the temporary changes. Scheduling a 20m call right before demo to confirm.

jun-sre: Applied: coalescing=on(org=beaconrun), burst+450 (expires 5h), ephemeral_ttl+30s. Monitoring now. infra-bot will post if errors persist.

redwood-ratebot: alert: org=beaconrun preflight spike (980 rpm) -> coalesce enabled; burst cap increased; ephemeral TTL extended. Monitoring 30m.

ria-cs: Thanks. Post-demo follow-ups: 1) ship SDK patch with BroadcastChannel singleflight + capped concurrency + jittered backoff; 2) docs page "Embedding SDKs in WebViews and multi-context apps" with `x-client-debounce-key` guidance; 3) consider adding a gateway-level header to opt-in automatic client debounce.

omar-eng: I'll open the SDK PR and draft the docs. Also will add a short sample for WebView environments (Android WebView + iOS WKWebView tips).

paula-support: I'll record the call and capture their feedback for the onboarding playbook.

ria-cs: Great job — demo proceeded after change. Leaving temporary settings to auto-revert in 5h unless CS asks to extend.
